_comment: Outside-view anchors for the Phase 7 calibration of century_sim.py. Every value is an external published estimate; ranges (not points) are used so the likelihood rewards worlds whose realised quantity falls inside the band. Signed off 2026-07-06; three end-state anchors (pandemic frequency, 2126 population, 2126 warming) added 2026-07-08. Every anchor carries a 'retrieved' date recording when its source was last checked, so a band that has fallen behind its evidence is visible without reading the source. calibrate_century.py reweights the v2 ensemble toward these; CENTURY_WEIGHTS=<weights> makes century_sim.py report the anchor-weighted tables alongside the unweighted ones. The population and warming anchors are survivor-conditional (they describe worlds that avoid a global catastrophe, matching the no-collapse premise of the UN and IPCC projections), so calibrate_century.py mean-imputes non-survivors on those two features to keep the moment survivor-scoped.
_agi_arrival_comment: The published forecasts split into two families that disagree by roughly two decades, and the split tracks the definition of AGI rather than any disagreement about evidence. (a) Economic-replacement definitions: Forecasting Research Institute LEAP Wave 8, fielded 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-11, n=264 matched experts and superforecasters, defining AGI as a commercially available system outperforming the 90th-percentile professional human in every primarily non-physical occupation on at least 90% of economically useful non-physical tasks at no more than 5x the cost of equivalent human labour; experts give 80% before 2100 with median 2050 (p25 2039, p75 2065), superforecasters median 2047. (b) Benchmark and Turing-test definitions: the Goodheart Labs AGI Timelines Dashboard combined forecast over Metaculus, Manifold and Kalshi, retrieved 2026-07-30, gives median 2031 with an 80% interval of 2027 to 2044. Century's threshold is a general capability crossing whose downstream dynamics are economic automation and takeover risk, which matches family (a) more closely than family (b), but the bands below are held wide enough to cover both because the definitional match is a judgement rather than a measurement. Note also that the LEAP percentiles may be conditional on occurrence before 2100 rather than unconditional; the published summary does not say which, and the two readings differ by about ten points on p_agi_by_2050.

agi_arrival_cdf.source: Two-family span (see _agi_arrival_comment): LEAP Wave 8 (2026) implies roughly 0.12-0.20 under an economic-replacement definition; the Goodheart Labs dashboard (2026-07-30) implies roughly 0.55-0.65 under benchmark definitions. The band spans both because the definitional match to Century's threshold is a judgement.

Two-family span (see _agi_arrival_comment): LEAP Wave 8 (2026) implies roughly 0.40-0.50; the Goodheart Labs dashboard (2026-07-30) implies roughly 0.85. The band spans both because the definitional match to Century's threshold is a judgement.

Two-family span (see _agi_arrival_comment): LEAP Wave 8 (2026) puts 20% on no AGI before 2100 under an economic-replacement definition, implying roughly 0.12-0.20 by 2126; benchmark-definition aggregates imply roughly 0.05. The band spans both because the definitional match to Century's threshold is a judgement.

extinction_by_2100.source: AI-researcher survey median P(extremely bad outcome) ~5%

nuclear_per_year.source: published great-power nuclear-war per-year estimates ~0.1%-1%/yr over ~100 yr; model base 0.3%/yr

pandemic_per_century.source: COVID-class-or-worse pandemics per century: 20th-21st century influenza pandemics (1918, 1957, 1968, 2009) plus COVID-19; Marani et al. 2021 PNAS extreme-epidemic frequency implies a few per century

population_2126_bn.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024 medium variant: global population peaks ~10.3bn around 2084 then declines; 2100 95% prediction interval ~8.9-11.6bn. Survivor-conditional (no global catastrophe)

warming_2126_C.source: IPCC AR6 WG1 (2021) 2100 best-estimate warming above 1850-1900: 1.4C (SSP1-1.9) to 4.4C (SSP5-8.5); central no-strong-mitigation SSP2-4.5 ~2.7C. Survivor-conditional (no global catastrophe)
